description.en: A folder that opens in a new File Explorer window becomes a tab of the window already open. Needs Windows 11 22H2 or newer
description.zh: 新开的文件夹窗口并到已经开着的资源管理器里，成为一个标签页。需要 Windows 11 22H2 或更新

notes.zh: 有的电脑上新开的文件夹窗口一直不并成标签页（诊断日志里是“1 known, 0 able”）：读不到资源管理器进程的权限级别时（安全软件常常不让读），插件把它当成了比自己高而跳过。现在按资源管理器平常的级别处理，日志也写明每个窗口没被选中的原因（#331）。需要主程序 0.32.0。权限不变。
notes.en: On some PCs new folder windows never became tabs ("1 known, 0 able" in the diagnostics): when Explorer's integrity level could not be read, as security software often refuses, the plugin took it as above its own and skipped it. It now counts as Explorer's usual level, and the log says why each window was passed over (#331). Requires WinShun 0.32.0. Permissions unchanged.
